scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 11-UNIT MAShQLAR, 3-BET (56-bet, PDF 55). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '11'.

CHAP USTUN:
6) 'Rewrite the sentences below, as in the example.' 1 I won't buy it. I don't have enough money. → If I had enough money, I would buy it. 2 She won't call you because she doesn't have your phone number. 3 I won't make my bed. I don't have time. 4 He won't go to the theatre because he doesn't like plays. 5 I won't watch it. I don't enjoy watching horror films.
7) 'Look at the sentences below, then offer solutions, as in the example.' 1 I don't feel well. (see a doctor) → If I were you, I would see a doctor. 2 I'm tired. (go to bed early) 3 I don't have any money. (get a job) 4 I'm hungry. (make a sandwich) 5 I need to lose some weight. (join a gym) 6 I want to learn French. (take French lessons) 7 My CD player has broken. (call the repairman) 8 I'm bored. (go for a walk)
8) 'Using the prompts from the list below complete the sentences, as in the example.' make a pizza, grow her own vegetables, go on a picnic, go roller-blading, send an e-mail to his friend, go skiing, play hockey, drive to the office. SURATLAR: 1 pitsa - I am not hungry. If I was hungry, I would make a pizza.

O'NG USTUN:
2 rolikda qiz - Jenny is at school. If she wasn't at school, ...... 3 bola kompyuterda - Steven doesn't have a computer. If Steven had a computer, ...... 4 ayol bog'da - Judy lives in a big city. If she lived in a small town, ...... 5 chang'ichi - It doesn't snow where Rob lives. If it snowed where Rob lives, ...... 6 erkak telefonda avtobusda - Mr Barry takes the bus to his office every day. If he owned a car, ...... 7 piknik - Laura works every day. If she took a day off, ...... 8 xokkey - They don't know how to ice-skate. If they knew how to ice-skate, ......

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '56'.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences below, as in the example. 1 I won't buy it. I don't have enough money. → If I had enough money, I would buy it. 2 She won't call you because she doesn't have your phone number. 3 I won't make my bed. I don't have time. 4 He won't go to the theatre because he doesn't like plays. 5 I won't watch it. I don't enjoy watching horror films.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarni qayta yozing, namunadagidek. 1 Uni sotib olmayman. Yetarli pulim yo'q. → Yetarli pulim bo'lganda, uni sotib olardim. 2 U senga qo'ng'iroq qilmaydi, chunki telefon raqamingni bilmaydi. 3 Yotog'imni yig'maymani. Vaqtim yo'q. 4 U teatrga bormaydi, chunki spektakllarni yoqtirmaydi. 5 Uni ko'rmayman. Qo'rqinchli filmlarni yoqtirmayman.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAQIQAT → XAYOL (2-tur).

  Inkor haqiqat (don't have) → If
  tasdiq past (had)
  won't → would

  2 If she had your phone number,
    she would call you.
  3 If I had time, I would make
    my bed.
  4 If he liked plays, he would go
    to the theatre.
  5 If I enjoyed watching horror
    films, I would watch it.

  ⚠ Inkor → tasdiqqa aylanadi.

    friend

  5 would go skiing

items.sentence: I am not hungry. If I was hungry, ___.
items.uz: Qornim och emas. Och bo'lganimda, pitsa qilardim. (NAMUNA)

items.sentence: Jenny is at school. If she wasn't at school, ___.
items.uz: Jenni maktabda. Maktabda bo'lmaganda, rolikda uchardi.

items.sentence: Steven doesn't have a computer. If Steven had a computer, ___.
items.answer: he would send an e-mail to his friend
items.uz: Stivenning kompyuteri yo'q. Kompyuteri bo'lganda, do'stiga e-mail yuborardi.

items.sentence: Judy lives in a big city. If she lived in a small town, ___.
items.answer: she would grow her own vegetables
items.uz: Judi katta shaharda yashaydi. Kichik shaharchada yashaganda, o'z sabzavotlarini yetishtirardi.

items.sentence: It doesn't snow where Rob lives. If it snowed where Rob lives, ___.
items.uz: Rob yashaydigan joyda qor yog'maydi. Qor yog'ganda, chang'i uchardi.

items.sentence: Mr Barry takes the bus to his office every day. If he owned a car, ___.
items.answer: he would drive to the office
items.uz: Berri janob har kuni ofisga avtobusda boradi. Mashinasi bo'lganda, ofisga mashinada borardi.

items.sentence: Laura works every day. If she took a day off, ___.
items.answer: she would go on a picnic
items.uz: Laura har kuni ishlaydi. Bir kun dam olganda, piknikka borardi.

items.sentence: They don't know how to ice-skate. If they knew how to ice-skate, ___.
items.uz: Ular muzda uchishni bilishmaydi. Bilganda, xokkey o'ynashardi.

patterns.formula: I won't ... I don't have ... → If I had ..., I would ...
patterns.exampleEn: I won't buy it. I don't have enough money. → If I had enough money, I would buy it.
patterns.exampleUz: Sotib olmayman. Pulim yo'q. → Pulim bo'lganda, sotib olardim.

patterns.formula: MUAMMO. — If I were you, I would + YEChIM.
patterns.exampleEn: I'm bored. — If I were you, I would go for a walk.
patterns.exampleUz: Zerikdim. — Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, sayr qilardim.

patterns.formula: HAQIQAT. If + TESKARISI (past), KIM + would + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Steven doesn't have a computer. If Steven had a computer, he would send an e-mail.
patterns.exampleUz: Stivenning kompyuteri yo'q. Bo'lganda, e-mail yuborardi.
